title: Meta Ads for Pet Groomers (2026) | DataLatte

facts.fact: LocaliQ's 2026 benchmark shows a cost per lead of $38.09 for the Personal Services category on leads campaigns.
facts.quote: Personal Services shows $1.62 per click, a 6.61% conversion rate and $38.09 per lead.

facts.fact: LocaliQ's 2026 benchmark shows a cost per lead of $50.91 for the Beauty & Personal Care category on leads campaigns.

facts.fact: LocaliQ's benchmark page was last updated 23 September 2026, covers 20 industries, and does not describe its sample.

facts.fact: The article states that the Animals & Pets $0.51 figure is a traffic-campaign click cost and should not be read as the price of a booking.
facts.quote: Traffic clicks are not leads, so do not read $0.51 as the price of a booking.

facts.fact: The guide is written for salon and mobile groomers in the US, UK, Australia and Canada.
facts.quote: This guide is for salon and mobile groomers in the US, UK, Australia and Canada.

facts.fact: The article's prices are in US dollars drawn from US benchmark data and should be treated as a range.
facts.quote: Prices are US dollars from US benchmark data, so treat them as a range.

facts.fact: The article's worked example uses an assumed monthly budget of $600 for each category; this is an illustrative assumption, not a sourced figure.
